title: refactor(metadata-core): look up a package's customization pair through the App that carries it (pairOf), behaviour unchanged
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGiPU3nfGMxJdPY5ydbkoUG)_

Refs #29594 (PR 1 of 5–7: the lookup refactor only; the ensure door returning the App's pair, the `customizable` verdict, the `sys_` pass-through close and the platform pair follow in later PRs)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6691022506

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「这个包的定制包是哪个」这个问题现在只有一个答案入口 `pairOf(base)`（在 `@objectstack/metadata-core`），它先问「这个包属于哪个 App」（`appOf`），再按 App 推出 `<id>.custom`。原来散在 metadata-protocol、objectql、两个 service 里的 20 处直接推导和 3 处 `isCustomizationPairOf` 判定都改走它。
- 为什么改：裁决 ① 定制单位 = App（HotCRM 四个包只有一个 `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`）。下一个 PR 只要改 `appOf` 一处，所有读写门、列表、卸载拒绝就一起按 App 找定制包，不会有漏改的地方各说各话。
- 风险与回滚：本 PR 不改任何行为：`appOf` 现在原样返回包自己，所以每处答案、拒绝原因、定制包 id 都和今天一模一样；`runtime` 的两处留给下一个 PR。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts`（整个查找就 3 个函数）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`（改动最多的一处，5 个调用点 + 1 处判定）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts`（被五个读路径共用的判定）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/customization-pair-lookup.test.ts`，预期 16 个用例全绿（App、模块、独立包、`sys` 内核包、无命名空间的包都与旧推导相同）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The lookup (`packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/metadata-core`).**

- `appOf(packageId)`: the App that carries a package for customization. Today the identity: every package is its own App, which is what every call site assumed.
- `pairOf(base)` = `customizationPackageId(appOf(base))`: the pair, or the same refusal the id rule names (`base_id_missing`, `base_is_customization_package`, `base_id_invalid`).
- `isPairOf(pairId, base)`: whether `pairId` is THE pair of `base`, the predicate `isCustomizationPairOf` answered.

The id rule itself stays in `@objectstack/spec/kernel`; `packages/spec` is untouched. **Why metadata-core and not metadata-protocol or objectql:** `service-datasource` (a class (i) site) declares neither of those, only `metadata-core`, and `metadata-core` is the one package every class (i) caller already declares (metadata-protocol, objectql, service-automation, service-datasource, runtime). No new dependency edge, no lockfile change. That is the criterion already used for the write dispatch predicates and the code-artifact provenance test in that package (claim amendment 6691222368).

**The call sites.** Each class (i) site now calls `pairOf` / `isPairOf` where it called `customizationPackageId(base)` / `isCustomizationPairOf(pair, base)`. Nothing else in those functions moved: same branches, same sentences, same refusal codes.

**Census** of `git grep -n customizationPackageId origin/main -- 'packages/**/*.ts' ':!*.test.ts'` at `69e133ea`: 53 hits in 17 files. (i) = "the pair of this package" derivation, routed through the lookup. (ii) = the definition, a parse ("is this id a pair"), an import, a doc mention or a field name; stays.

| File | Hits | (i) routed | (i) deferred | (ii) stays |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `lint/src/validate-customization-namespace.ts` | 3 | 0 | 0 | 3: import, doc, L108 is-a-pair skip (the `base_is_customization_package` reason on the manifest's own id, the same parse as `isCustomizationPackage(manifest.id)`) |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts` | 3 | 1 (L255, ensure door's pair id) | 0 | 2: import (removed), doc (reworded) |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts` | 2 | 1 (L330, pair translation bundle) | 0 | 1: import |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-environment-rows.ts` | 2 | 1 (L296, `baseAddressServesMember`) | 0 | 1: import |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` | 3 | 2 (L408, L413) | 0 | 1: import |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` | 4 | 3 (L197, L531, L675) | 0 | 1: import |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-overlay-merge.ts` | 2 | 1 (L114) | 0 | 1: import |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` | 7 | 5 (L197, L217, L419, L684, L1075) | 0 | 2: import, doc |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts` | 3 | 1 (L383) | 0 | 2: import, doc |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-served-overrides.ts` | 2 | 1 (L98) | 0 | 1: import |
| `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-gates.ts` | 2 | 1 (L330, `pairOfAddedMember`) | 0 | 1: import |
| `objectql/src/registry.ts` | 6 | 1 (L7311, uninstall refusal) | 0 | 5: import, 2 docs, `PackageUninstallExtendedError.customizationPackageId` field declaration + assignment (a public property name, not a derivation) |
| `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` | 4 | 0 | 2 (L669 `customizeInPairRemedy`, L3628 package customizations read) | 2: import, doc |
| `services/service-automation/src/flow-precedence.ts` | 2 | 1 (L259, `undeclaredRemedy`) | 0 | 1: import |

| `spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1: doc |
| **Total** | **53** | **20** | **2** | **31** |

Class (i) is 22 (the ruling estimated about 20): 20 routed here, 2 in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` left for PR 2 by the order, because #30756 (same seat) is editing that file.

Plus 3 `isCustomizationPairOf(pair, base)` sites, the same derivation through a second spec helper, routed to `isPairOf` (claim amendment 6691222368): `metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts:88` (`isServedOverrideRowOf`, the predicate five reads share), `protocol-class-head.ts:190` (restore intent), `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:1076` (declared-override gate, which already reads `pairOf` two lines up). After this PR, `git grep -n "customizationPackageId(\|isCustomizationPairOf(" -- 'packages/**/*.ts' ':!*.test.ts' ':!packages/spec/**'` answers 4 lines: the lookup itself, lint's is-a-pair skip, and the 2 deferred runtime sites.

**Not in this PR:** the ensure door resolving a member to its App and answering the App's pair (200), the `customizable` verdict, the `sys_` pass-through in `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`, the platform pair, the ADR-0146 D3 amendment (#31014, spec seat). Kernel objects stay not customizable: ③ is ruled (6691217245), the kernel whitelist (Users, Organizations) is a later version's work.

## Tests

New `packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.test.ts` (16 cases): for an App package (`app.objectstack.hotcrm`), a module its artifact brings (`app.objectstack.hotcrm.service`, still its own pair today), a standalone package, a `sys` kernel package (`com.objectstack.plugin-auth`, scope `system`) and a manifest with no namespace, `appOf` is the identity and `pairOf` equals `customizationPackageId` and the literal pair; the five refusals match the id rule; `isPairOf` equals `isCustomizationPairOf` over seven candidates per row.

The existing suites of every touched package are the behaviour pin: they assert the served answers (pair ids in refusal sentences, served override rows, list and layered reads, uninstall refusal, flow precedence remedy, datasource import landing) and none of them changed.

<details><summary>Ablation (appOf moved off the identity, twice)</summary>

Both mutations through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the line `  return packageId;` of `customization-pair-lookup.ts`, each restored and proved (`blob == HEAD bd176c7702ab`, `git diff HEAD` empty, whole-tree `git status --porcelain` empty).

1. Source, the unit table: `return packageId === 'app.objectstack.hotcrm.service' ? 'app.objectstack.hotcrm' : packageId;` (the HotCRM module resolved to its App). `Tests 2 failed | 14 passed (16)`: the module row's `appOf` (`Expected: "app.objectstack.hotcrm.service"`, `Received: "app.objectstack.hotcrm"`) and its `isPairOf` (`expected false to be true`). The other rows stay green.
2. Through `dist/`, the consumers: `return packageId === 'com.acme.crm' ? 'com.acme.suite' : packageId;`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core build`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/metadata-core '"com.acme.suite"' --source-marker=…` exit 0 (marker in 2 built files). `metadata-protocol` `served-override.test.ts`, `protocol.pair-translation-bundle.test.ts`, `protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`, `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts`: **48 failed** (23 + 22 + 1 + 2), for example `Expected: "'com.acme.crm.custom' (?package=com.acme.crm.custom)"`, `Received: "… save it into 'com.acme.suite.custom' (?package=com.acme.suite.custom) …"`. So the write gates, the served-override predicate and the pair translation read ask the lookup through the published build. Restore, rebuild, preflight `--absent` exit 0 (absent from all 12 built files), tree clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against this diff, every line run with stdin closed, exit codes recorded before any pipe: record `/mnt/project-files/server-seat-2/r2026-11-06/out/29594-gates-ran-33e47fa35.list`. `--ran` reconciliation: **65 derived, 64 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**; every run family exit 0.

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's `dist/`; this worktree built the closure of the touched packages, not the whole workspace). CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it on a full build.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first answered exit 3 on the shallow clone (pinned fixture commit `621a4876` unreachable); after `git fetch origin 621a4876…` it is exit 0 (48 cases).

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (the contract review's reading: three new names on the published `@objectstack/metadata-core` entry), patch on `@objectstack/metadata-core` (three new exports), `metadata-protocol`, `objectql`, `service-automation`, `service-datasource` (their dist now imports the lookup). No served answer changes, so `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Deferred to PR 2, named here so it is not lost:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` L669 and L3628 (now L672 / L3737 after the merge). The parse direction (`customizationBasePackageId` in cli `package/install.ts`, cloud-connection `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, runtime, metadata-protocol) is class (ii) and stays: it maps a pair to its base, which under the App unit is the App.
- **Outside this census (`packages/**` only), for PR 2's rehearsal and the `domain:ui` half:** six client-side derivations in `ui/packages/app-shell` call `customizationPackageId` from the spec directly: `views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx:211`, `views/studio-design/AutomationsFlowRail.tsx:367`, `BuilderLanding.tsx:163`, `CustomizationMark.tsx:143`, `customizationMarks.ts:58`, `packages-io.ts:239`. They answer the same as the server today; once `appOf` resolves a module to its App they would still derive the module's own pair (for example `app.objectstack.hotcrm.service.custom`) until the console reads the served pair (ruling 6691022506 routes that to `domain:ui`, after #29591).
- **For PR 2:** the module row of the new unit table (`app.objectstack.hotcrm.service` → `app.objectstack.hotcrm.service.custom`) pins today's answer on purpose; it is the row the App resolver is meant to flip.
- `PackageUninstallExtendedError.customizationPackageId` keeps its name: it is a public error property, and renaming it is not part of a no-behaviour-change refactor.
- GitHub writes: this PR through the fleet-write relay `pr_create`; the harness's assignee/reviewer step is skipped per the dispatch frame (the seat assigns at hand-over).

Head after the review fixes: `678d6d6e` (changeset declaration + one test docblock line).
